policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV text reads 'the testimony of God' (μαρτύριον); the mapped textual_variant note 'Many ancient authorities read mystery' relegates μυστήριον to the margin.
Word order and construction only (τι εἰδέναι vs τοῦ εἰδέναι τι); 'I determined not to know anything' renders either identically and no note is mapped here.
ASV 'in persuasive words of wisdom' has an unitalicized 'words' (λόγοις), excluding the base πειθοῖ σοφίας, and lacks any 'man's/human' rendering ἀνθρωπίνης, excluding the RP reading.
Word order only (θεοῦ σοφίαν vs σοφίαν θεοῦ); 'God's wisdom' renders either and the only note here is an alternative_rendering on 'worlds'.
ASV shifts from 'Things which' for the preceding relatives to 'Whatsoever things God prepared', the quantitative ὅσα rather than the simple relative ἅ.
ASV text reads 'But unto us God revealed them' (δὲ); the mapped textual_variant note 'Some ancient authorities read For' puts γάρ in the margin.
Word order only (ἀπεκάλυψεν ὁ θεός vs ὁ θεὸς ἀπεκάλυψεν); 'God revealed' renders either, and the verse's textual note is mapped to the γάρ/δέ unit, not this one.
ASV 'through the Spirit' has no possessive 'his', which the added αὐτοῦ would require.
ἔγνωκεν and οἶδεν are both rendered 'knoweth' in ASV; nothing in the wording and no mapped note distinguishes them.
ASV 'which the Spirit teacheth' lacks 'Holy', which the added ἁγίου would require.
ASV 'judgeth all things' renders πάντα either with the article τά or with the correlative μέν left untranslated; both notes here are alternative_rendering on 'examineth/examined'.
